name: AlphaZC Technology Image Gallery
author: Syed Naeem Tariq

sections.description:
AlphaZC Technology Image Gallery lets you upload, manage, and display images directly from /wp-content/uploads/technology/. It includes:

  • Shortcodes for a grid or carousel view
  • SwiperJS-based responsive carousel
  • Admin panel to upload and delete images
  • Customizable gallery options from settings
  • Lightweight and simple interface

No media library bloat — just a clean, focused image management plugin.

Shortcodes:
– [alphazc_tech_gallery] — display images in a responsive grid
– [alphazc_tech_gallery_carousel] — display images in a Swiper carousel

Credits

  • SwiperJS: https://swiperjs.com/

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install via WordPress dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to “Technology Gallery” in the admin sidebar.
  4. Upload your images.
  5. Use shortcodes [alphazc_tech_gallery] or [alphazc_tech_gallery_carousel] in any post or page.
sections.faq:
Where are the images stored?

In a custom folder: /wp-content/uploads/technology/

Can I use this plugin with other gallery plugins?

Yes, but this plugin uses its own custom upload folder and is independent.

Does it support multiple image uploads?

Not yet — currently supports one-at-a-time uploads.

Can I customize carousel settings?

Yes! Go to AZC Technology Gallery > Gallery Settings to adjust slide size, spacing, autoplay, and more.
